name: CASH
oneLiner: CASH is Phantom and Bridge Building's centralized USD stablecoin on Solana, redeemable 1:1 and backed by short-term U.S. Treasuries, repos, and MMFs.
collateral: U.S. Treasury bills (≤3 months maturity), reverse repurchase agreements backed by U.S. Treasuries, U.S. government money-market funds, deposit accounts, and tokenized equivalents held in segregated bankruptcy-remote accounts
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption via Bridge Building Inc. (BBI) with reserves held in bankruptcy-remote custodial accounts

applicabilityBasis.summary: CASH is a Bridge-issued U.S. dollar payment stablecoin for Phantom with 1:1 redemption through Bridge.

genius.notes: Bridge Building Inc. (BBI), the legal issuer of CASH via Bridge Open Issuance, is a Stripe subsidiary and licensed state money transmitter (NMLS #2450917). On Feb 12, 2026, the OCC conditionally approved Bridge Ventures LLC (BVL, BBI's parent) to organize Bridge National Trust Bank (OCC Corporate Decision #1365), a new federally chartered national trust bank that would issue stablecoins and custody digital assets under direct OCC oversight. This conditional trust-bank charter covers a new bank entity under BVL, not BBI directly; BBI remains a state money transmitter. Because the chartered entity is not yet formed and BBI is the actual CASH issuer, issuerPathway remains unknown rather than federal-qualified-nonbank. Bridge markets its platform as GENIUS-ready but no token-specific PPSI approval or official GENIUS application has been filed or publicly disclosed for CASH. authorizationStatus stays issuer-announced-intent. No enforcement actions found.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official PPSI application was located for CASH. The OCC conditional trust bank charter (CD-1365, Feb 2026) applies to a new bank entity under Bridge Ventures LLC, not to BBI (the actual CASH issuer). The PPSI application framework remains in proposed-rulemaking phase as of 2026-06-18.

upgradeability.controlRef: CASH Bridge program single-key upgrade authority

mintAuthority.summary: CASH's Token-2022 mint authority is a PDA of Bridge program BkP8..., which has two active mint routes under allowances and a 20-million-CASH per-call limit. A single Bridge governance EOA can change roles, allowances, and limits immediately, while a separate single EOA can upgrade the Bridge program and bypass those checks. HyperEVM CASH can reach the Solana OFTStore through LayerZero; its token administrator can create source CASH, while route owners alone cannot. The OApp, Token-2022, LayerZero Endpoint, and two HyperEVM proxies add independent upgrade domains.

controls.label: CASH Bridge program two-route mint surface
controls.capDescription: Bridge enforces a 20,000,000-CASH per-call limit. Backend EOA 3ZGf... had 228,398,515.21 CASH remaining allowance at the cutoff; LayerZero OFTStore 3cQm... had 999,999,997.993 CASH. Governance EOA E7Jd... can change roles, allowances, the per-call limit, and the 1-billion-CASH maximum allowance immediately.
bypassSurfaces: Governance EOA E7JdFMP5AqdndJKstZV2mHdekLwAQbNWRHMpoozyB3qw can change roles and limits immediately.
Program upgrader 76m8dWSAYTuNWMfZS5tR1Az8sYnCGkEJ8WYWJhxAhQ5Q can replace Bridge mint logic with no delay.
controls.evidence: At Solana slot 432714278, this PDA was CASH mintAuthority and Bridge GlobalConfig DNGzc... named governance EOA E7Jd.... Exactly two active minter roles existed: backend EOA 3ZGf... with reconstructed cutoff allowance 228,398,515.21 CASH, and LayerZero OFTStore 3cQm... with 999,999,997.993 CASH. Each mint also required an active recipient role, reserve-ledger mint RD1S..., an unpaused config, remaining allowance, and the 20-million per-call bound. The last pre-cutoff backend mint at slot 432709220 corroborates the live path.

controls.label: CASH Bridge governance and mint-policy EOA
controls.evidence: At the cutoff, Bridge GlobalConfig named this on-curve funded system account as governance. It can immediately transfer governance, grant or revoke minter and recipient roles, reset allowances, change per-transaction and maximum-allowance limits, and pause minting. The same address is the CASH permanent-delegate, mint-close, and confidential-transfer authority; separate token-extension authorities do not add mint capability.

controls.label: CASH Bridge program single-key upgrade authority
controls.evidence: At slot 432714278, Bridge ProgramData H79WsaPgtctdpmhykRQZ91r8HNr5uqxUWEBe6DZXuhMu retained this on-curve system account as upgrade authority. The executable was last deployed at slot 398305763; authority-transfer transaction 23bi... at slot 401157588 changed the prior authority to this key, with no later change. The program bytecode hash was e8c6010b00363865407339574716f4c25c7042408611c75f0569521391abbfc5. It can replace mint logic immediately and invalidate every current allowance check.

controls.label: CASH Solana OApp route administrator
controls.evidence: At the cutoff, OFTStore 3cQmk45EJhd1WhNU9PP14ihZ27JzKtsFwy3fwXBT7Dty named this on-curve funded system account as admin. It can change admin, delegate, trusted peer, route maximum, token-authority configuration, pause state, and frozen receiver. It cannot mint by itself: the OApp signer remains bounded by the current Bridge minter role, allowance, and 20-million per-call limit.

controls.label: CASH Solana OApp single-key upgrade authority
controls.evidence: At slot 432714278, OApp program 2UvSehbvxnufkbY9VYmDpKFriXVbb5rQ5unrcCqDqB1G used ProgramData CYVLd3XvpowaKGG4Q521uu261Jhcao2WSGiYb889UXoL, last deployed at slot 402512195, and retained this single EOA upgrader. It can rewrite receive logic and use the OFTStore signer immediately, but the separate Bridge program still enforces its allowance and per-call limit unless another authority acts.

controls.label: Solana Token-2022 shared-program upgrade authority
controls.evidence: At the cutoff, Token-2022 ProgramData DoU57AYuPFu2QU514RktNPG22QhApEjnKxnBcu4BHDTY named this authority. It is authority index 1 of immutable Squads V3 multisig BnD53519LK7QM4ERBGvLedZDe1VoTPgtiBkGPWAACiMZ with threshold 4, six members, and no execution delay.

controls.label: Solana LayerZero Endpoint shared-program upgrade authority
controls.evidence: At the cutoff, LayerZero Endpoint program 76y77prsiCMvXMjuoZ5VRrhG5qYBrUMYTE5WgHqgjEn6 used ProgramData 9RJbAS28AVA4WamkGMHBA3eymx4AsoPWAbJkN28CqJCz and retained authority 4QMp.... That PDA is authority index 1 of immutable Squads V3 multisig DazbcrVYizBrecec7vHJnSrhinc6y3nMWtkPj76hudui, threshold 4 of 5 with no timelock. Replacing Endpoint verification does not by itself raise the separate Bridge OFTStore allowance.

controls.label: CASH HyperEVM token and TokenAuthority administrator
controls.evidence: At HyperEVM block 40381118, this no-code EOA solely held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on TokenAuthority proxy 0xD457... and inner CASH proxy 0x061A..., and solely held MINT_RATE_LIMIT_SETTER_ROLE. Inner CASH granted MINTER_ROLE only to TokenAuthority and had a 1-billion-CASH max supply. The EOA can grant roles, raise that maximum, and create source CASH that the valid OFT can burn and route to Solana; destination minting remains bounded by the current Solana allowance and per-call limit unless a Solana authority also acts.

controls.label: CASH HyperEVM token and TokenAuthority upgrade EOA
controls.evidence: At block 40381118, TokenAuthority UUPS proxy 0xD457... used implementation 0x1d2dbfd7b4b6be108550eb57d59323b2a486b03d and inner CASH UUPS proxy 0x061A... used implementation 0x1d83d3a4923f8d9efb57ddf9fffc0c24d58c3744. Verified source requires DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE for both upgrades; this sole EOA can replace either path immediately.

controls.label: CASH HyperEVM OFT route owner
controls.evidence: At block 40381118, direct verified OFT 0x1b64... named this no-code EOA as owner and trusted Solana OFTStore 3cQm... for destination EID 30168. The owner can change peers, tokenAuthority, and destination limits, but cannot create source supply: _debit first transfers real inner CASH and then burns it, so a no-op tokenAuthority does not manufacture tokens.

review.evidence: At the fixed cutoff, Solana slot 432714278 and HyperEVM block 40381118 resolved the complete CASH supply graph. The Bridge program had exactly two active minter routes and one immediate governance EOA, but its ProgramData retained a separate single-key upgrader, correcting the prior false immutable conclusion. The Solana OApp and shared Token-2022 and LayerZero Endpoint runtimes were independently upgradeable. The sole HyperEVM token administrator could create source CASH and upgrade both inner proxies; the direct OFT owner and Solana OApp admin could change route parameters but could not manufacture supply alone.
